lines.en: label cafe35:
scene firstotoha1
I wind up showing up to the cafe after taking an obnoxiously long detour.
lines.zh: 绕了一段长得离谱的远路之后，我总算到了咖啡馆。

lines.en: The path I normally take here was completely blocked off for construction or something so, after an extra fifteen minutes of finding an alternate route, I’m finally here.
lines.zh: 我平时来这儿的那条路被完全封死了，好像是在施工什么的，于是我多花了十五分钟找替代路线，才终于到了这里。

lines.en: scene firstotoha2
: Oh, good morning.
lines.zh: : 哦，早上好。

lines.en: : We were just wondering when you were going to show up.
lines.zh: : 我们刚才还在想你什么时候会来呢。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Rin’s post-heartbreak excursion is today.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。Rin 的失恋后散心之旅是今天。

lines.en: : I may or may not have forgotten about that.
lines.zh: : 我可能忘了，也可能没忘。

lines.en: scene firstotoha3
: So you just happened to show up at the cafe at the exact time we were supposed to go out on accident?
lines.zh: : 所以你是碰巧在我们该出门的时间，「不小心」出现在咖啡馆的？

lines.en: : Yeah, kind of.
lines.zh: : 对，差不多吧。

lines.en: : I would have shown up fifteen minutes earlier but I think they’re building something nearby.
lines.zh: : 我本来能早到十五分钟的，可我觉得附近好像在建什么东西。

lines.en: scene firstotoha4
: Is that what all of that traffic was about? I had no idea.
lines.zh: : 那些堵车就是因为那个吗？我完全不知道。

lines.en: : We came from the opposite direction, but some of the roads were backed up over there as well.
lines.zh: : 我们是从相反方向过来的，不过那边有些路也堵上了。

lines.en: : I wonder what they’re building?
lines.zh: : 不知道他们在建什么？

lines.en: : Beats me.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。

lines.en: I look around the cafe, expecting to see Rin behind the counter or something, but can’t seem to find her at all.
lines.zh: 我环顾咖啡馆，本以为会看到 Rin 站在柜台后面什么的，却怎么也找不到她。

lines.en: : So, where’s our leader?
lines.zh: : 那么，我们的领队呢？

lines.en: scene firstotoha2
: In the bathroom doing her makeup.
lines.zh: : 在洗手间化妆呢。

lines.en: : She’s feeling much better today.
lines.zh: : 她今天心情好多了。

lines.en: : Really? What happened?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？发生什么了？

lines.en: scene firstotoha3
: If anyone should know what happened, it’s you.
lines.zh: : 要说谁最清楚发生了什么，那应该是你吧。

lines.en: : Rin told me you were the one who let Chika into the room the other night so the two of them could talk.
lines.zh: : Rin 跟我说，那天晚上是你放 Chika 进房间，好让她们两个谈谈。

lines.en: scene firstotoha2
: Well, apparently that talk went really well.
lines.zh: : 嗯，看来那次谈话进行得非常顺利。

lines.en: : And even though nothing has really changed since then, she’s definitely held her head up a little higher.
lines.zh: : 虽然从那之后其实什么都没变，但她的头确实抬得高了一点。

lines.en: : Hm? Who you guys talkin’ about?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你们在说谁呢？

lines.en: scene firstotoha5
Rin rounds the corner and stops in front of me, playfully punching me in the arm and feigning obliviousness to the fact that we're talking about her.
lines.zh: Rin 转过拐角，在我面前停下，开玩笑地捶了下我的胳膊，装作不知道我们在聊她。

lines.en: : Welcome back to the world of the living.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回到活人的世界。

lines.en: : Thank ya! Glad to be here!
lines.zh: : 谢啦！很高兴回来！

lines.en: : And thanks again for all of your help since the beach.
lines.zh: : 还有，从海边那次之后一直麻烦你照顾，再次谢谢你。

lines.en: : I already thanked Futaba like six million times, but I really don’t think I would have gotten over this so quickly if it weren’t for you two.
lines.zh: : 我已经谢过 Futaba 大概六百万次了，不过说真的，要是没有你们两个，我不可能这么快走出来。

lines.en: : There’s no need to thank us. We’re just happy you don’t look like a zombie anymore.
lines.zh: : 不用谢我们。我们只是很高兴你不再像个僵尸了。

lines.en: scene firstotoha6
: As am I, dearest Futaba.
lines.zh: : 我也很高兴，亲爱的 Futaba。

lines.en: : I can finally venture forth and be among normal people once again. It feels great to be alive.
lines.zh: : 我终于可以重新出门、回到正常人中间了。活着的感觉真好。

lines.en: scene firstotoha7
: Do you know the plan, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你知道今天的计划吗？

lines.en: : Nope. I honestly still don’t even know where we’re going.
lines.zh: : 不知道。老实说，我到现在连我们要去哪儿都不知道。

lines.en: : Ohohoh, then you’re in for a treat.
lines.zh: : 哦嚯嚯，那你可要享福了。

lines.en: : We’re returning to our native land at the far reaches of the outer-barrier.
lines.zh: : 我们要回到外围屏障最远处的故土。

lines.en: : The what?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : She means the area where our old school is.
lines.zh: : 她指的是我们以前的学校那一带。

lines.en: : Some people call it the outer-barrier because of the wall that was erected to prevent people from leaving the city.
lines.zh: : 有些人管那儿叫外围屏障，因为那边修了一堵墙，防止人们离开这座城市。

lines.en: : Is there an...inner barrier?
lines.zh: : 有……内屏障吗？

lines.en: : Nope. Just the outer one. But that’s beside the point.
lines.zh: : 没有。就只有外面那一道。不过这不重要。

lines.en: : All you need to know is that you’ll be seeing our old stomping-ground for the first time.
lines.zh: : 你只要知道，你将第一次见到我们以前的地盘。

lines.en: : I haven’t been there ever since we moved, so I might be a little lost. But Futaba is there pretty often so she’ll be able to show us around.
lines.zh: : 我们搬走之后我就再也没去过，可能会有点迷路。不过 Futaba 常去那儿，她能带我们逛。

lines.en: : Why do you still go over there, Futaba?
lines.zh: : Futaba，你为什么还往那边跑？

lines.en: scene firstotoha8
: Oh, a good friend of mine still goes to the [high_school] in that part of town.
lines.zh: : 哦，我有个好朋友还在那一带的 [high_school] 上学。

lines.en: : Wait...if there is a [high_school] over there, why did you two wind up coming here?
lines.zh: : 等等……那边既然有 [high_school]，你们俩怎么跑到这儿来了？

lines.en: : You didn't move for the sole purpose of coming to this[school], did you?
lines.zh: : 你们不是为了来这所[school]才搬家的吧？

lines.en: scene firstotoha9
: Oh...Well, um...That’s-
lines.zh: : 哦……那个，嗯……那是——

lines.en: : N-Nevermind that! It’s old news and doesn’t matter at all.
lines.zh: : 那、那个就别提了！都是陈年旧事，一点都不重要。

lines.en: scene firstotoha10
: What {i}does{/i} matter is getting this show on the road!
lines.zh: : 真正{i}重要{/i}的是赶紧出发！

lines.en: : The last stage of fixing a broken heart is buying a bunch of stuff to get yourself over the final hurdle.
lines.zh: : 治愈一颗破碎的心的最后一步，就是买一堆东西，帮自己跨过最后那道坎。

lines.en: : So is that what we’re doing? Shopping?
lines.zh: : 所以我们要做的就是……逛街？

lines.en: : Shopping. Eating. Enjoying life. You name it.
lines.zh: : 逛街。吃东西。享受人生。想干嘛干嘛。

lines.en: I really didn’t expect to be spending the majority of my day tagging along with girls while they buy clothes, but...
lines.zh: 我真没想到自己今天大部分时间都要跟着女孩子买衣服，不过……

lines.en: Hey, maybe they’ll be willing to sample outfits for me or something?
lines.zh: 嘿，也许她们愿意给我试穿几套什么的？

lines.en: There’s got to be a bright side to this, right?...
lines.zh: 这事总该有好的一面吧，对吧？……

lines.en: scene black
Okay, so there was no brightside.
lines.zh: 好吧，没什么好的一面。

lines.en: We went into roughly fifteen stores and I did not get to see them sample even one article of clothing for me.
lines.zh: 我们逛了大约十五家店，而我连一件衣服都没看到她们为我试穿。

lines.en: What is it with girls?
lines.zh: 女孩子到底是怎么搞的？

lines.en: How are they able to do things like spending hours upon hours in department stores without buying anything?
lines.zh: 她们怎么能一连好几个小时泡在百货公司里，什么都不买？

lines.en: I’ll never understand it.
lines.zh: 我永远都搞不懂。

lines.en: scene firstotoha11
After department store number 20 or 21 (I’ve honestly lost count), we begin to make our way to some dessert place that Rin and Futaba know about.
lines.zh: 在第 20 还是 21 家百货店之后（老实说我已经数不清了），我们开始往 Rin 和 Futaba 知道的一家甜品店去。

lines.en: : Look at this trooper, still standin’ tall after chaperoning two [young]lasses into half of the clothing stores in the city.
lines.zh: : 看看这位勇士，陪着两位[young]姑娘逛遍了城里一半的服装店，还站得笔直。

lines.en: : Sorry for not buying anything. I just haven’t really been able to find anything that looks good on me...
lines.zh: : 抱歉什么都没买。我只是实在没找到适合自己的……

lines.en: : Yeah, same here. But hey, that just means more money for food, am I right?
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也一样。不过话说回来，那就意味着更多钱能花在吃的上了，我说得对吧？

lines.en: : Another bright side to the fact that you two haven’t bought anything is that it's actually a huge plus for me.
lines.zh: : 你们俩什么都没买，对我来说还有另一个好处，那就是这其实对我是天大的好事。

lines.en: : Why? Cause you think you’d end up carrying it?
lines.zh: : 为什么？因为你觉得自己最后得拎包？

lines.en: : Because I {i}know{/i} I’d end up carrying it.
lines.zh: : 因为我{i}知道{/i}我最后得拎包。

lines.en: : Excuse me, good sir, but who did most of the heavy lifting when Molly was moving into her dorm?
lines.zh: : 恕我直言，这位先生，Molly 搬进宿舍的时候，重活大多是谁干的？

lines.en: : Me.
scene firstotoha12
: Heck no you didn’t! I carried like, triple the amount of boxes you did!
lines.zh: : 才不是！我搬的箱子是你的三倍好吧！

lines.en: : Yeah, but they were all light. Who’s the one who carried her eight hundred gaming chairs upstairs?
lines.zh: : 是啊，可都是轻的。那把她八百张游戏椅扛上楼的是谁？

lines.en: scene firstotoha13
: Bad homie! You’re supposed to only say nice things about me today. I’m wounded.
lines.zh: : 不够意思！你今天应该只说我的好话。我受伤了。

lines.en: : Sorry, Rin. I’ll make sure to give you any leftover compliments after you drain my wallet at the dessert buffet.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Rin。等你在甜品自助餐把我的钱包榨干之后，我一定把剩下的夸奖都给你。

lines.en: scene firstotoha14
: Oh, you don’t have to worry about that. I’m treating Rin today.
lines.zh: : 哦，这个你不用担心。今天我请 Rin。

lines.en: : What, really? You don’t have to do that. Sensei can pay.
lines.zh: : 什么，真的？你不用这样。Sensei 可以付啊。

lines.en: Why is it okay for {i}me{/i} to do it?...
lines.zh: 为什么换成{i}我{/i}付就理所当然了？……

lines.en: scene firstotoha15
: Mhm. My parents gave me an advance on my allowance, so I have some extra money to spare.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我爸妈预支了我的零花钱，所以有多余的钱。

lines.en: : They still give you an allowance even though you don’t work for it or anything?
lines.zh: : 他们还会给你零花钱？就算你什么活都不干？

lines.en: : Well, it’s not like there’s really anything I can do for them when they’re thousands of miles away...
lines.zh: : 嗯，他们在几千公里之外，我也没什么能替他们做的……

lines.en: : True, true. But you don’t have to use that on me, you know. I’m perfectly fine with Sensei paying.
lines.zh: : 也是，也是。不过你不用把钱花在我身上啊。Sensei 付钱我完全没意见。

lines.en: : Is paying for yourself a thing that has even crossed your mind today?
lines.zh: : 今天你脑子里有没有闪过「自己付」这个念头？

lines.en: scene firstotoha16
: Hm? Did you say something? I can’t really hear you over the sound of the guitar.
lines.zh: : 嗯？你说什么？吉他声太大了，我听不太清。

lines.en: scene firstotoha17
: Wait, guitar?
lines.zh: : 等等，吉他？

lines.en: : What’s going on down there?
lines.zh: : 下面那边怎么回事？

lines.en: scene firstotoha18
I turn around to see a girl around the same age as Rin and Futaba playing guitar in the center of a small park.
lines.zh: 我转过身，看到一个和 Rin、Futaba 年纪相仿的女孩，正在一座小公园的中央弹吉他。

lines.en: It’s hard to hear from all the way over here, but it looks like she’s singing as well.
lines.zh: 从这儿这么远很难听清，不过她好像还在唱歌。

lines.en: scene firstotoha17
Rin stops dead in her tracks as she watches the girl play.
lines.zh: Rin 看着那女孩弹琴，整个人猛地停住了脚步。

lines.en: It’s hard to tell what she’s thinking, but she becomes absorbed within a matter of seconds.
lines.zh: 很难说她在想什么，但几秒钟之内她就完全沉浸了进去。

lines.en: scene firstotoha19
: We have time to stop and watch for a little while, right?
lines.zh: : 我们有时间停下来看一会儿吧？

lines.en: : I think it would make Rin really happy.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这会让 Rin 很开心。

lines.en: : Hey, this isn’t my day. It’s hers. If she wants to go watch guitar-girl for a little while, that’s fine by me.
lines.zh: : 嘿，今天不是我的日子，是她的。她想去看一会儿弹吉他的女孩，我没意见。

lines.en: : Woah...
: She’s really good.
lines.zh: : 她真的很厉害。

lines.en: : Do you guys hear her?
lines.zh: : 你们听见了吗？

lines.en: : It’s kind of hard to from up here.
lines.zh: : 从上面这儿有点难听清。

lines.en: : Did you want to get closer?
lines.zh: : 你想走近点吗？

lines.en: scene firstotoha20
: Yes! Please!
lines.zh: : 想！拜托了！

lines.en: : Come with me!
lines.zh: : 跟我来！

lines.en: scene black
Rin nearly jumps down the entire flight of stairs and dashes over to the park.
lines.zh: Rin 几乎是整段楼梯一路跳下去的，然后冲进了公园。

lines.en: I worry that something like that might make a scene because it’s rather busy around here but, somehow or another, no one seems to notice...
lines.zh: 我有点担心这样会引人注目，毕竟这一带人挺多的，可不知怎么的，似乎没人注意到……

lines.en: scene firstotoha21
We wind up stopping a decent distance away from the girl, who’s busy playing and singing to a small and mostly inattentive group of people.
lines.zh: 最后我们在离那女孩一段合适的距离处停下，她正忙着弹唱给一小群大多心不在焉的人听。

lines.en: But despite the lack of attention she’s getting from the crowd, she’s surprisingly good.
lines.zh: 尽管人群没怎么注意她，她的水平却出奇地好。

lines.en: Her words are clear and emotional. And even though I don’t know much about music, her guitar playing seems pretty good as well.
lines.zh: 她的歌词清晰又富有感情。虽然我对音乐一窍不通，但她的吉他弹得似乎也很不错。

lines.en: Rin stands still, taking in every ounce of the performance. It's almost like she's getting lost in it.
lines.zh: Rin 一动不动地站着，把表演的每一分每一秒都吸进去。她几乎像是整个人陷了进去。

lines.en: Futaba stands to her side, gently tapping her foot and nodding her head along with the music.
lines.zh: Futaba 站在她旁边，轻轻打着拍子，跟着音乐点头。

lines.en: : ...{i}Untie the knot around your finger set me loose again{/i}-
lines.zh: : ……{i}解开你指间缠绕的结，让我重新获得自由{/i}——

lines.en: : {i}I'm longing for a chance to breathe and-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我渴望一次呼吸的机会，然后——{/i}

lines.en: scene firstotoha22
: {i}A chance to make amends-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}一次弥补的机会——{/i}

lines.en: scene firstotoha23
: Oh my God, she looked at me.
lines.zh: : 天哪，她看我了。

lines.en: : She’s still looking at you.
lines.zh: : 她还在看你。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : Probably because you seemed interested.
lines.zh: : 大概因为你看上去很感兴趣吧。

lines.en: : No one else was really paying attention.
lines.zh: : 别的人都没怎么在听。

lines.en: : Is it safe to look back?
lines.zh: : 回头看安全吗？

lines.en: : Why wouldn’t it be?
lines.zh: : 为什么不安全？

lines.en: : I don’t know, dude. It’s embarrassing. She’s pretty and talented and I...have a ponytail!
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊，兄弟。太丢人了。她又漂亮又有才华，而我……只有一条马尾辫！

lines.en: : Is there something wrong with ponytails that I'm not aware of?
lines.zh: : 马尾辫有什么问题吗，我怎么不知道？

lines.en: scene firstotoha24
: I DON’T KNOW! LEAVE ME ALONE!
lines.zh: : 我不知道啦！别烦我！

lines.en: scene firstotoha25
The girl with the guitar goes through the chorus one more time before finishing her song and staring at the ground.
lines.zh: 弹吉他的女孩又把副歌走了一遍，唱完歌后低头盯着地面。

lines.en: She takes a few moments to catch her breath before beginning to pack her things up.
lines.zh: 她花了几秒钟喘匀气，然后开始收拾东西。

lines.en: The music that had seamlessly blended in with car horns and sidewalk chatter fades into nothingness and, once again, we’re left without a clear goal in mind.
lines.zh: 那原本与汽车喇叭和人行道上的喧哗融为一体的音乐渐渐消散，而我们又一次失去了明确的目标。

lines.en: scene firstotoha26
: Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei。

lines.en: : I call upon you for help.
lines.zh: : 我需要你的帮助。

lines.en: Well, one of us seems to have a goal, apparently.
lines.zh: 看来我们当中有一个人是有目标的。

lines.en: : What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : I want to talk to her.
lines.zh: : 我想跟她说话。

lines.en: : Are you in love again?
lines.zh: : 你又恋爱了？

lines.en: : Of course not. But...she’s really cool and really pretty and...maybe we could play together or something.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。不过……她真的很酷、很漂亮，而且……也许我们可以一起玩点什么。

lines.en: : Like, guitar I mean. Not sexually.
lines.zh: : 我是说，吉他。不是那种意义上的玩。

lines.en: : Unless she wanted to.
lines.zh: : 除非她想。

lines.en: scene firstotoha27
: AHHH! Just help me!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！你帮我就对了！

lines.en: I wonder how vulnerable Rin is at a time like this?
lines.zh: 不知道这种时候的 Rin 有多容易被逗？

lines.en: I suppose now is as good a time as any to find out...
lines.zh: 我想现在正是弄清楚的好时机……

lines.en: : Okay, okay. Just look at her and repeat after me. Got it?
lines.zh: : 好，好。看着她，跟着我重复。明白了吗？

lines.en: scene firstotoha26
: Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : First, tell her...{i}I love your music! I came running the second I heard it!{/i}
lines.zh: : 首先，跟她说……{i}我好喜欢你的音乐！我一听见就跑过来了！{/i}

lines.en: : Roger!
lines.zh: : 收到！

lines.en: scene firstotoha28
: Uh...ummm! I love your music! I came running the second I heard it!
lines.zh: : 呃……嗯嗯！我好喜欢你的音乐！我一听见就跑过来了！

lines.en: : Wow, really?! Thank you so much!
lines.zh: : 哇，真的吗？！太谢谢你了！

lines.en: : You have no idea how much it means for me to hear that!
lines.zh: : 你根本不知道听到这句话对我有多重要！

lines.en: : Now tell her, {i}You’re very pretty. Like...supermodel-pretty.{/i}
lines.zh: : 现在告诉她，{i}你非常漂亮。就像……超模那么漂亮。{/i}

lines.en: : A-Also! You’re very pretty! Like a supermodel!
lines.zh: : 还、还有！你非常漂亮！就像超模一样！

lines.en: scene firstotoha29
: Oh, come on...that's not true. You’re just trying to make me blush.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样……才没有呢。你只是想让我脸红吧。

lines.en: : Okay, ready for the final move?
lines.zh: : 好了，准备好最后一招了吗？

lines.en: : Hit me, wingman.
lines.zh: : 来吧，僚机。

lines.en: : With every ounce of confidence in your body, shout...{i}I would give anything just to kiss you!{/i}
lines.zh: : 用尽你全身每一个细胞的自信，大喊……{i}只要能亲到你，我什么都愿意给！{/i}

lines.en: : I-I would give anything just to kiss you!
lines.zh: : 我、我只要能亲到你，什么都愿意给！

lines.en: scene firstotoha30
: Wait, what?! What are you making me say?!
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？！你让我说的是什么啊？！

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Cool?...
: Okay...Futaba to the rescue.
lines.zh: : 好了……Futaba 来救场。

lines.en: scene black
Futaba pushes both myself and Rin toward the girl, who carefully places her guitar back in her case and comes to stand next to us.
lines.zh: Futaba 把我和 Rin 一起推向那女孩，女孩小心地把吉他放回琴盒，走过来站到我们旁边。

lines.en: scene firstotoha31
: Hey! We just wanted to say we really liked your performance.
lines.zh: : 嗨！我们只是想说，我们真的很喜欢你的表演。

lines.en: : And {i}I{/i} want to say that I am so, SO sorry for that...last thing I said.
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}想说的是，我对刚才……最后那句话真的非常、非常抱歉。

lines.en: : You mean the part about kissing me?
lines.zh: : 你是说亲我那句？

lines.en: scene firstotoha32
: Yuuuuup...That’s the one...
lines.zh: : 是————啊……就是那句……

lines.en: : Don’t sweat it...I’ve heard much weirder stuff playing out here. Trust me.
lines.zh: : 别在意……在这儿演出，我听过的怪话多了去了。相信我。

lines.en: : Do you perform here often?
lines.zh: : 你常在这儿演出吗？

lines.en: scene firstotoha33
: Every weekend, pretty much. So if you ever get bored and want to come watch, feel free.
lines.zh: : 基本上每个周末都来。所以你们要是哪天无聊了想来看，随时欢迎。

lines.en: : I don’t ask for money or anything. I’m just kind of doing this for fun.
lines.zh: : 我不收钱什么的。就只是图个开心。

lines.en: : Do you...go to[school] around here?
lines.zh: : 你……在附近这所[school]上学吗？

lines.en: : Mhm. I’m a first-year at the [high_school] a couple miles away.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我是几英里外那所 [high_school] 的一年级生。

lines.en: : So you’re in the same grade as us then.
lines.zh: : 那你是和我们同年级了。

lines.en: : Do you know Nodoka Nagasawa by any chance?
lines.zh: : 你认不认识 Nodoka Nagasawa？

lines.en: scene firstotoha34
: Ah! Nodoka! I {i}do{/i} know her!
lines.zh: : 啊！Nodoka！我{i}认识{/i}她！

lines.en: : I’m always going to her for writing tips and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我老去找她讨教写作什么的。

lines.en: : That girl’s like...a pillar of infinite wisdom.
lines.zh: : 那姑娘简直就是……一座无穷智慧的支柱。

lines.en: scene firstotoha35
: Yeah...She definitely knows a little too much for her own good at times...
lines.zh: : 是啊……她有时候知道得确实有点太多了，对她自己没好处……

lines.en: : Umm...Is it cool if I ask you for your name?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我、我可以问你的名字吗？

lines.en: scene firstotoha36
: Why? Need it for your next pickup line?
lines.zh: : 为什么？留着当下一次搭讪台词？

lines.en: scene firstotoha37
: Okay. Time to go back into depression-mode.
lines.zh: : 好吧。是时候回到抑郁模式了。

lines.en: : It’s been a good day, everyone. Rin Rokuhara is signing off.
lines.zh: : 今天很开心，各位。Rin Rokuhara 正式下线。

lines.en: scene firstotoha38
: Otoha. Otoha Okakura.
lines.zh: : Otoha。Otoha Okakura。

lines.en: : It’s nice to meet you, Rin. You don't have to sign off yet.
lines.zh: : 很高兴认识你，Rin。你还不用下线呢。

lines.en: scene firstotoha39
: Y-Yeah! It’s really nice to meet you too!
lines.zh: : 是、是啊！我也很高兴认识你！

lines.en: : I promise to be less weird in the future!
lines.zh: : 我保证以后会少那么一点怪！

lines.en: scene firstotoha40
: Speaking of weird, who’s this guy?
lines.zh: : 说到怪，这位是谁？

lines.en: : Boyfriend for one of you two?
lines.zh: : 你们俩谁的男朋友？

lines.en: : Oh, no. That’s just some guy. He’s been following us around for like two miles now.
lines.zh: : 哦，不是。就是个路人。他已经跟着我们走了大概两英里了。

lines.en: : I thought about calling the police, but my phone died.
lines.zh: : 我想过报警，可我手机没电了。

lines.en: : She’s lying. I’m their teacher.
lines.zh: : 她骗你的。我是她们的老师。

lines.en: scene firstotoha41
: Their teacher?
lines.zh: : 她们的老师？

lines.en: : Then what are you doing out with them on the weekend?
lines.zh: : 那你周末跟她们出来干什么？

lines.en: : He’s not exactly a normal teacher...
lines.zh: : 他算不上什么正经老师……

lines.en: : I’m really not.
lines.zh: : 我真不是。

lines.en: scene firstotoha42
: Well, uhh...Okay then.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个……好吧。

lines.en: Yeah, that’s pretty much the reaction I’d expect out of any [high_school] girl who {i}isn’t{/i} in my class.
lines.zh: 是啊，任何一个{i}不在{/i}我班上的 [high_school] 女孩，大概都会是这种反应。

lines.en: scene firstotoha43
: Anywho, I need to be getting a move on. I’ve got some stuff I need to take care of before tonight.
lines.zh: : 总之，我得走了。今晚之前还有点事要处理。

lines.en: : It was really nice meeting you all, though!
lines.zh: : 不过认识你们真的很高兴！

lines.en: scene firstotoha44
: Oh! And Nodoka’s friend- I didn’t get your name! Tell me who you are and I’ll tell her I ran into you.
lines.zh: : 哦！还有，Nodoka 的朋友——我还没问你的名字呢！告诉我你是谁，我就跟她说我碰见你了。

lines.en: : Oh, Futaba Fukuyama. You don’t need to tell her, though. I’m sure I’ll be seeing her again soon anyway.
lines.zh: : 哦，Futaba Fukuyama。不过你不用特意告诉她，反正我很快也会再见到她的。

lines.en: : Nah, nah. Totally telling her first thing Monday morning. We have science together.
lines.zh: : 不不不。周一早上一到学校我就告诉她。我们一起上科学课。

lines.en: scene firstotoha45
: And you! Make sure you take good care of these girls.
lines.zh: : 还有你！一定要好好照顾这些女孩。

lines.en: : You’re a lot older, so people might get the wrong idea if they see you out and about with them after dark.
lines.zh: : 你年纪大那么多，要是天黑后被人看见你跟她们在外面晃，别人可能会想歪。

lines.en: : They’re in good hands...
lines.zh: : 她们在我手里很安全……

lines.en: Kind of.
lines.zh: 算是吧。

lines.en: : Well, I don’t really have any reason to distrust you right now. So I guess they are.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不过我现在也没什么理由不信你。所以我想她们确实很安全。

lines.en: scene firstotoha43
: Anyway, I’ll see you later! Thanks for listening to me play!
lines.zh: : 那好吧，回头见！谢谢你们听我弹琴！

lines.en: : I’m here every weekend if you ever want to come say hi!
lines.zh: : 我每个周末都在这儿，你们想来打招呼随时欢迎！

lines.en: scene firstotoha46
: W-We will!
lines.zh: : 我、我们会的！

lines.en: : ...See ya.
lines.zh: : ……回头见。

lines.en: scene black
Shortly after that, the three of us make our way over to the dessert buffet.
lines.zh: 在那之后不久，我们三个人动身去了甜品自助餐厅。

lines.en: We spend almost three hours there as Rin apparently has seventeen stomachs when it comes to dessert.
lines.zh: 我们在那儿待了差不多三个小时，因为 Rin 一碰到甜点就像有十七个胃一样。

lines.en: And even though Futaba offers to foot the bill for both her and Rin, I ultimately wind up paying for everyone.
lines.zh: 尽管 Futaba 提出替她和 Rin 两人付账，最后还是我给所有人买了单。

lines.en: I figure it’s the least I can do to thank them for a surprisingly fun day in a part of town I’ve never seen before.
lines.zh: 我想，在我从没来过的这一带度过了意外有趣的一天，这至少算是我对她们的一点感谢。

lines.en: And hey, we even managed to meet someone new.
lines.zh: 而且嘿，我们还认识了新朋友。

lines.en: I wonder if Rin and Futaba will wind up going back to see her again sometime soon?
lines.zh: 不知道 Rin 和 Futaba 会不会很快再去看她？

lines.en: I can’t imagine myself ever wanting to go {i}that{/i} far away just to spend time with a girl, so there’s no guarantee I’ll ever see Otoha again.
lines.zh: 我无法想象自己会为了跟一个女孩待在一起而跑{i}那么{/i}远，所以我也没把握还能不能再见到 Otoha。

lines.en: But even if I don’t, I’m glad that she was able to make Rin smile.
lines.zh: 但就算见不到，我也很高兴她让 Rin 露出了笑容。

lines.en: That was the happiest I’ve seen her in quite some time...
lines.zh: 那是我很长一段时间以来见过的她最开心的样子……
